headline: Move It PH Fined P555.75 Million by Transport Regulator
summary: The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board ordered ride-hailing app Move It PH to pay a P555.75 million fine for onboarding motorcycle riders beyond the authorized cap.
why: Regulatory penalties and compliance caps directly affect the operational capacity and financial performance of ride-hailing platforms.

impacts.name: Move It PH
impacts.why: The company was ordered to pay a substantial regulatory fine.
